description: Ultimate Slicer- Expanded list, Hierarchy, Date picker, Date- Heatmap, Button, Dropdown list, Switch, Text Slicer and more. “Powerviz Slicer Panel – A unified, all-in-one slicer for Power BI that makes filtering smarter, simpler, and more interactive.” Powerviz Slicer Panel is an advanced slicer that combines expanded lists, dropdowns, sliders, buttons, date pickers, switches, text slicers, and more into a single, intuitive panel. With built-in templates, full customisation, and import/export options, it streamlines filtering and delivers a modern, interactive experience for smarter data exploration. Check out the live demo here. Key Feature Highlights Display Mode: Seamlessly switch between popup, canvas & Popup by Slicer mode to accommodate different dashboard designs. Canvas: Displays slicers directly on the report canvas for always-visible interaction. Popup: Collapse the visual into a compact bar and open slicers in a Popup with a single click. Popup by Slicer: Displays each slicer as an individual pop-up button for focused and compact filtering. Orientation: Defines how slicers are arranged. Position: Determines where the slicer panel appears on the screen — left, right, top, or bottom. List: Displays all available items in a simple list format for quick selection. Expanded List: Shows all items with clear visibility, allowing easy multi-selection…
